The '''Malachor III Expedition''' was a mission undertaken by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] around the time of the [[Great Galactic War]] on the dead [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malachor III]] in hoping to found ancients Sith secrets. Unfortunately, the Jedi underestimated the dangers of the place and sent only six [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Parkanas Tark]], [[Yuon Par]], [[Duras Fain]], [[Sidonie Garen]], [[Eriz Vossan]] and [[Cin Tykan]]. Their arrival awakened the [[Force ghost/Legends|dark spirit]] of the dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] [[Terrak Morrhage]]. Morrhage's spirit played with the emotions of the young Jedi and drove them insane. While the rest of the team managed to escape the planet, Tark was left behind to be tortured by Morrhage and, eventually, Morrhage's dark spirit corrupted and possessed him.
